updateserver.name: Visitor Stats
updateserver.desc: See who has been visiting your websites: visitors per day and month, pages, referrers, search terms, browsers and the busiest hours, made every hour with Visitors 0.7.
updateserver.updatedesc: The page in the panel's style (domain picker, when the report was made, Reload and New window), the report itself restyled to match the panel's Light or Dark and sized to fit, and its own sidebar icon.
